email.subject1: a signal play for PandaDoc's partners
email.body1:
David, saw PandaDoc named Keith Rabkin CEO and is rolling out major AI agreement-workflow features this year.

A leadership reset plus a product push usually means the partner ecosystem can source more co-sell pipeline than the team can cover. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner network on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PandaDoc's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
David, quick follow-up for PandaDoc.

Partner-sourced pipeline usually outruns the team's ability to activate it, so warm co-sell intros sit cold and the partnership underdelivers. The fix is coverage at scale, not more BD hires.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and how PandaDoc can run partner-sourced outreach at scale, with every touch personalized to the partner's accounts.
email.body3:
David, last bit of proof for PandaDoc.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged.

I pulled a benchmark of how PandaDoc's partner reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
David, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right now, no problem at all. A leadership transition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through three personalized drafts to your top partner targets plus a co-sell playbook? I will tailor it to PandaDoc either way.
